system.biography:
has guardian angel bot

 

 ere are worse things than not knowing who you were. Being dead, for one.
You died during the Fall, You were an Ivorian-French army
commandant who somehow gained the sobriquet “the Butcher
of Paris.” You don’t recall the details; you were restored from a
backup made weeks before. You’ve been unable to learn what
you did to earn it, but the name haunts you, clinging to your
rep, even following you to Extropia, where you began
selling your skills. You took security gigs on gatecrashing
ops to gain even more distance. It’s on one of these that
you survived an exsurgent virus outbreak and took an
invite to Firewall
